transcript: This summer, join one country project board members, national leaders, rural advocates, and policy experts for our fourth annual World Progress Summit, July 8th through the 10th. Our keynote will feature a virtual fireside chat between me and Secretary Pete Buttigieg. As a former transportation secretary and small city mayor, Pete brings a unique perspective on the challenges facing our country, especially the rural parts of our country. The Rural Progress Summit is a virtual event that reaches rural Americans where they are. Rural communities play a vital role in shaping America's future, yet way too often they're left out of key policy conversations. This summit brings together voices from across the country to explore ideas and solutions that address the real needs of rural America. Go to onecountryproject.org to learn more, or you can follow the link in this episode's show notes to register for the online summit. It's free. We hope you will join us there. Joining me today on the hot dish is a great friend, Senator Debbie Stabenow, who in the United States Congress has forgotten more about agriculture than most people ever knew. And I have been watching with amazement at the work that you've been able to do with Growing Climate Solutions Act and the fact that you found a bipartisan path forward for all things climate legislation. And so if you could just give us a little background on how that came together, Senator, we'd really appreciate it.
